metadata.name: Arctic Freshwater Fluorescence Measurements – Nuna WP4 Mackenzie Expedition 2019
metadata.description: Dataset of 146 observations collected between 2019-04-20 and 2019-09-08 during the Nuna WP4 Mackenzie Arctic expeditions (Expedition 1‑4). Each record provides a timestamp (UTC), latitude, longitude, water depth, expedition and station identifiers, and fluorescence metrics (IFDOM C1‑C3, FDOM A‑peak, C‑peak, M‑peak, T‑peak, fDOM FI, HI, BI). Five rows lack all fluorescence values, and the column FDOM T‑peak is a duplicate of FDOM C‑peak.
metadata.spatial: Point locations in WGS‑84 (EPSG:4326) with coordinate precision of ~0.001° (≈100 m north‑south, ≈30 m east‑west at 69° N).
